Name: Eye-tracking event annotation (Tobii Pro Lab export)

GeneratedBy.Name: Tobii Pro Lab
GeneratedBy.Description: Gaze, pupil, eye-movement classification (Tobii I-VT fixation filter), scene-camera media info, IMU, and TTL sync events (SyncPortInHigh/SyncPortInLow) exported from Tobii Pro Lab.

SourceDatasets.Description: Raw BIDS eye-tracking dataset (Tobii Pro Glasses 2).

Recording timestamp [μs].Description: Recording timestamp in the eye-tracker clock.

Computer timestamp [μs].Description: Recording timestamp in the computer clock.

Sensor.Description: Sensor that produced the sample (eye tracker, gyroscope, accelerometer, etc.).

Recording Fixation filter name.Description: Name of the fixation filter applied to the eye-tracking data in the export.

Event.Description: Name of the event/marker. TTL sync pulses appear as SyncPortInHigh (rising) / SyncPortInLow (falling); recording bounds as RecordingStart / RecordingEnd.

Gaze point X [MCS px].Description: Raw 2D gaze coordinate, both eyes combined, on the media/scene (X axis). Coordinates in the Media Coordinate System.

Gaze point Y [MCS px].Description: Raw 2D gaze coordinate, both eyes combined, on the media/scene (Y axis). Coordinates in the Media Coordinate System.

Gaze point 3D X [HUCS mm].Description: Vergence point of the left and right gaze vectors (X axis). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System.

Gaze point 3D Y [HUCS mm].Description: Vergence point of the left and right gaze vectors (Y axis). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System.

Gaze point 3D Z [HUCS mm].Description: Vergence point of the left and right gaze vectors (Z axis). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System.

Gaze direction left X [HUCS norm].Description: Unit vector of the left-eye gaze direction (X component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System. Values are normalized.

Gaze direction left Y [HUCS norm].Description: Unit vector of the left-eye gaze direction (Y component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System. Values are normalized.

Gaze direction left Z [HUCS norm].Description: Unit vector of the left-eye gaze direction (Z component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System. Values are normalized.

Gaze direction right X [HUCS norm].Description: Unit vector of the right-eye gaze direction (X component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System. Values are normalized.

Gaze direction right Y [HUCS norm].Description: Unit vector of the right-eye gaze direction (Y component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System. Values are normalized.

Gaze direction right Z [HUCS norm].Description: Unit vector of the right-eye gaze direction (Z component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System. Values are normalized.

Pupil position left X [HUCS mm].Description: 3D position of the left-eye pupil (X component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System.

Pupil position left Y [HUCS mm].Description: 3D position of the left-eye pupil (Y component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System.

Pupil position left Z [HUCS mm].Description: 3D position of the left-eye pupil (Z component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System.

Pupil position right X [HUCS mm].Description: 3D position of the right-eye pupil (X component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System.

Pupil position right Y [HUCS mm].Description: 3D position of the right-eye pupil (Y component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System.

Pupil position right Z [HUCS mm].Description: 3D position of the right-eye pupil (Z component). Coordinates in the Head Unit Coordinate System.

Pupil diameter left [mm].Description: Estimated diameter of the left-eye pupil.

Pupil diameter right [mm].Description: Estimated diameter of the right-eye pupil.

Validity left.Description: Whether the left eye was correctly identified.

Validity right.Description: Whether the right eye was correctly identified.

Recording media name.Description: Name of the recording media (scene-camera video).

Eye movement type.Description: Eye-movement event class from the fixation filter.

Eye movement event duration [ms].Description: Duration of the currently active eye-movement event.

Eye movement type index.Description: Auto-increment index, starting at 1 for each eye-movement type.

Fixation point X [MCS px].Description: Coordinate of the fixation point (X axis); affected by the fixation-filter settings. Coordinates in the Media Coordinate System.

Fixation point Y [MCS px].Description: Coordinate of the fixation point (Y axis); affected by the fixation-filter settings. Coordinates in the Media Coordinate System.

Ungrouped.Description: Tobii Pro Lab 'Ungrouped' column (samples/events not assigned to a group).

Gyro X [°/s].Description: Angular velocity about the X axis (gyroscope).

Gyro Y [°/s].Description: Angular velocity about the Y axis (gyroscope).

Gyro Z [°/s].Description: Angular velocity about the Z axis (gyroscope).

Accelerometer X [m/s²].Description: Linear acceleration along the X axis.

Accelerometer Y [m/s²].Description: Linear acceleration along the Y axis.

Accelerometer Z [m/s²].Description: Linear acceleration along the Z axis.
